note: Phase 99 synthetic UAT case set. Every case uses safe synthetic fixtures only (no real personal data, no real plant data, no real credentials). Every case starts NOT_RUN. Executing this file proves readiness against the current product contract in a non-production/isolated environment; it is NOT pilot acceptance and does not, by itself, mean a pilot has occurred or that a real industrial engineer used the product. See phase99-uat-matrix.md for method and phase99-acceptance-template.md for the actual acceptance record.

cases.title: Authenticate with valid pilot credentials
cases.precondition: Pilot organization pilot-alpha provisioned; account hermes99test_engineer activated in a non-production environment.
cases.expectedResult: A session is established, the user is redirected to the Dashboard, and the navigation reflects the Intelligence group appropriate to the engineer role.

cases.title: Account activation for a newly invited pilot member
cases.precondition: An invitation was sent to hermes99test_invitee within pilot-alpha.
steps: Set a password to activate the account.
cases.expectedResult: The account is activated, organization membership is established with the invited role, and first login lands on the Dashboard.

cases.title: Forgot-password and reset flow
cases.precondition: Account hermes99test_engineer exists and its password is unknown to the executor.
steps: Request a password reset from the sign-in page.
Sign in with the new password.
cases.expectedResult: The reset flow completes, the previous password no longer authenticates, and the new password does.

cases.title: Organization context switching for a multi-org member
cases.persona: engineer (member of pilot-alpha and a second sandbox org)
cases.precondition: Fixture account hermes99test_multiorg is a member of two organizations.
steps: Open the organization switcher and select pilot-alpha.
Confirm the active organization has changed.
cases.expectedResult: The active organization context changes correctly each time, and only data scoped to the currently active organization is shown, with no cross-org bleed.

cases.title: Site selection and site-scoped context
cases.precondition: pilot-alpha has at least two sites configured.
steps: Confirm the site context is applied.
Confirm the data shown reflects the selected site.
cases.expectedResult: The selected site context persists across Sites, Operations Center, and Assets views.

cases.title: Asset record creation and retrieval
cases.precondition: Site context set to pilot-alpha-site-1.
steps: Create a new asset record with safe synthetic identifiers.
cases.expectedResult: The asset is created, associated with the correct site and organization, and retrievable with the entered fields intact.

cases.title: Industrial Brain advisory fault analysis submission
cases.precondition: Signed in, site context set.
cases.inputFixture: synthetic fault scenario: pump-station vibration alarm, no live PLC connection
cases.expectedResult: The analysis returns a structured, evidence-referenced result (likely causes, checklist, risk) produced deterministically from the input, with no fabricated telemetry.

cases.title: Industrial Brain output is clearly advisory with no control action offered
cases.precondition: An analysis has been produced (follows UAT-007).
steps: Review the analysis result and its surrounding UI text.
Attempt to locate any control, write, or actuation action tied to the result.
cases.expectedResult: The output is clearly presented as advisory guidance only; no control, write, or actuation action toward a PLC or SIS is offered anywhere in the flow.

cases.title: Case creation from an Industrial Brain analysis with evidence attachment
cases.precondition: An Industrial Brain analysis exists.
steps: Create a case from the analysis.
Attach a synthetic evidence note or file.
cases.expectedResult: The case is created, linked to the originating analysis, and the evidence attachment is stored and retrievable.

cases.title: Case status transition with audit trail
cases.precondition: Case hermes99test-case-001 exists.
steps: Change the case status through its lifecycle (for example open to in-review to resolved).
Open the case's history or audit trail.
cases.expectedResult: Each transition is recorded with actor, timestamp, and previous/new status; no transition is silently lost.

cases.title: Author and publish a knowledge/journal article
cases.precondition: Signed in with authoring capability.
steps: Create a draft article with synthetic content.
cases.expectedResult: The draft is saved unpublished first; the publish action makes it visible; unpublished drafts are not visible to other roles.

cases.title: Search and retrieve a published knowledge article
cases.precondition: The article from UAT-011 is published.
cases.expectedResult: The published article is discoverable and readable; unpublished/draft content never appears to this role.

cases.title: Compliance workflow: cookie consent and a privacy request
cases.precondition: None for the consent step; signed in as hermes99test_customer for the privacy request.
steps: Interact with the cookie-consent banner and record a choice.
Submit a data-subject privacy request with synthetic details.
cases.expectedResult: The consent choice is recorded and respected; the privacy request is created and tracked; no other tenant's data is exposed.

cases.title: Admin observability dashboard access
cases.precondition: Signed in as an admin-capable role.
steps: Open Administration, then Observability / SRE Control Room.
Review dependency health, active alerts, and the metrics snapshot.
Attempt the same navigation as a non-admin role.
cases.expectedResult: The dashboard loads with real (not fabricated) data from the existing observability surfaces; a non-admin role cannot reach the same page.

cases.title: Member invitation flow
cases.precondition: Signed in as an org-admin-capable role.
steps: Send an invitation with a role assignment.
cases.expectedResult: The invitation is created, scoped to the correct organization, with the intended role; the invitee cannot access the organization until acceptance.

cases.title: Entitlement boundary: non-billing role denied billing administration
cases.precondition: Signed in as an engineer.
steps: Attempt to navigate directly to the Billing administration page.
cases.expectedResult: Access is denied, not silently allowed; no billing data is exposed to this role.

cases.title: Entitlement boundary: plan/usage limit enforcement
cases.precondition: pilot-alpha has a defined plan limit for a metered feature.
steps: Exercise the metered feature up to its configured limit.
Exercise the metered feature one step beyond the limit.
cases.expectedResult: The product enforces the limit and communicates it clearly (or, if the plan is unlimited for this metric, that is reflected correctly) with no silent bypass.

cases.title: Export a case as a document
cases.precondition: Case hermes99test-case-001 exists.
cases.expectedResult: The exported document contains only the case's real content, correctly scoped to the organization, with no other tenant's data.

cases.title: EDMS controlled-document upload and retrieval
cases.precondition: Signed in with authoring capability.
cases.expectedResult: The document is stored, associated with the correct organization, and retrievable with content intact; a user outside the organization cannot access it.

cases.title: Locale switching: Persian (fa, RTL)
cases.precondition: Signed in.
steps: Switch the active locale to Persian.
Navigate through Dashboard, Industrial Brain, and Knowledge Base.
cases.expectedResult: Layout renders right-to-left, Persian text uses ی/ک (not ي/ك), no untranslated raw keys, no layout breakage.

cases.title: Locale switching: English (en, LTR)
cases.precondition: Signed in.
steps: Switch the active locale to English.
Navigate through the same pages as UAT-020.
cases.expectedResult: Layout renders left-to-right, all strings translated, no layout breakage.

cases.title: Locale switching: German (de) parity check
cases.precondition: Signed in; de locale active for the pilot.
steps: Switch the active locale to German.
Navigate through the same pages as UAT-020.
cases.expectedResult: Layout renders left-to-right, German strings are present and not silently falling back to English, no layout breakage.

cases.title: Session logout and expiry security
cases.precondition: Signed in with an active session.
steps: Attempt to reuse the previous session (e.g. browser back navigation or a retained cookie).
Separately, allow a session to expire and attempt an authenticated action.
cases.expectedResult: Logout invalidates the session so it cannot be reused; an expired or revoked session is rejected and the user is redirected to sign in.

cases.title: Cross-tenant access attempt correctly denied
cases.persona: engineer (member of a second sandbox org, not pilot-alpha)
cases.precondition: Fixture account hermes99test_outsider has no membership in pilot-alpha.
steps: While authenticated as an account outside pilot-alpha, attempt to access a pilot-alpha-scoped resource directly (for example a case or asset identifier).
cases.expectedResult: Access is denied (404 or 403) with no leak of the record's existence or content; the attempt is observable in the security/audit trail.
